subject.title: [AI] fix(daemon): set default NODE_OPTIONS --max-old-space-size in gateway service env

question: Should managed gateway and node services adopt a fixed 8192 MiB V8 old-space ceiling now despite constrained-host and custom-`NODE_OPTIONS` upgrade tradeoffs?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and addresses a severe observed crash loop, but startup defaults, affected service scope, and operator override behavior are intentional compatibility choices that source inspection cannot decide.

options.title: Accept emergency default
options.body: Land the heap-only 8192 MiB generated default now and track durable host-specific tuning separately.

options.title: Require tuning first
options.body: Pause until an approved config or CLI contract defines constrained-host behavior and has fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow service scope
options.body: Apply the mitigation only to gateway services if independently managed node services should retain their current startup behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept emergency default
recommendation.body: Land the heap-only 8192 MiB generated default now and track durable host-specific tuning separately.
